basis: Congenital atresia of a bronchus; confined to the respiratory tract.
Predominantly a uterine smooth-muscle tumour; reproductive tissue has no axis. Smooth muscle alone does not establish musculoskeletal involvement.
Systemic hypersensitivity disorder; episodic rash, hypotension and airway symptoms do not establish lasting damage to additional organs.
Eye/lung malformations and ID define syndrome; ID 80-99%; cardiovascular malformations 30-79%. Renal hypoplasia and other renal defects are generally occasional.
Benign papillary epithelial tumour arising in the kidney.
CoQ10 biosynthesis disorder with peripheral neuropathy and neurodevelopmental dysfunction; supplied renal, cardiac and hearing findings lack evidence of frequency ≥30%.
Intestinal motility disorder causing impaired absorption and diarrhea; no additional organ damage is established.
Muscular dystrophy, hearing loss (10/11) and ovarian endocrine failure define syndrome; respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness rather than direct lung disease.
Progressive spinal and epiphyseal dysplasia with intellectual disability explicitly defining the Kohn subtype, despite occasional frequency tags for individual ID grades.
Drug-induced inflammation of the exocrine pancreas; the treatment-induced pancreatitis itself is the disease being labelled.
Primary melanoma arising in cutaneous melanocytes; no common additional site of direct involvement applies across the group.
Necrotizing arterial vasculitis; ischemic neuropathy ~60-70%, renal vascular/ischemic involvement ~40-60%. Common skin and gastrointestinal involvement omitted by cap.
Congenital duplication cyst of the esophagus; respiratory symptoms do not establish common direct pulmonary damage.
Inherited narcolepsy-cataplexy disorder; obesity, sleep apnea and diabetes are separate associated conditions. A MOG variant alone does not establish autoimmunity.
Heme-synthesis disorder with cutaneous phototoxic injury; anemia, gallstones and transaminase elevation are occasional (5-29%); common hepatic damage is not established.
Pure anxiety disorder without defined damage to any of the 13 organ axes.
Inherited intestinal brush-border enzyme deficiency affecting sucrose and starch digestion; a carbohydrate metabolic disorder localized to the intestine.
Epilepsy defined by an enduring cerebral predisposition to stimulus-triggered seizures; triggering sensory organs are not themselves damaged.
Brachydactyly, intellectual disability and recurrent inflammatory episodes define syndrome; inflammatory mechanism is less certain. Pericardial effusion/perianal abscess occur in 5-29%.
Lymphoid hematologic malignancy arising in sternal bone or adjacent soft tissue; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune axis.
Predominantly ovarian cystic germ-cell tumour; reproductive origin has no axis. Differentiated tissue within the tumour does not establish other organ involvement.
Non-syndromic intellectual disability with microcephaly; skeletal and damaging ocular findings occur in only 1/6 patients each.
Vasovagal reflex causes episodic hypotension and/or bradycardia with syncope; transient cerebral hypoperfusion does not establish neurologic damage.
Orofacial malformation syndrome with cleft palate (22/27), cleft lip (15/27) and lip pits (14/27); mouth and oral structures map to gastrointestinal.
Intellectual disability and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism define syndrome; craniosynostosis and delayed skeletal maturation occur in 80-99%. Small nails do not establish skin damage.
